verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS company-formation and compliance platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions one. The only related item is a pricing line about 'Advanced API integrations', which is an adjacent feature and not a CLI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
